name: Ripped Doll
description: At the start of the first 2 turns of combat, Conjure.
flavor: The last reminder of your prior self. It still holds latent magicks.

name: Bronze Core
description: The first time you create a Function each combat, gain [E].

name: Champion's Crown
description: Once per combat, you may enter a Stance you are not in.

name: Emerald Torch
flavor: The fires of greed never fade.

name: Mob Leader's Staff
description: At the start of each combat, gain [E], draw 1 card, and Swap to the next Gremlin.
flavor: Among gremlin mobs, the one with the best horn maintains complete command over the troupe, until another one manages to steal it.

name: Bronze Gear
description:
At the start of each combat, gain Gear Up.
Guardian starts the run with a random common Gem.
flavor: Protection where you need it most.

name: Old Locket
description: At the start of each combat, add a Memento into your hand.

name: Spirit Brand
description: The first time you Ignite a Ghostflame each turn, gain 4 Block.

name: Heart of Goo
description: Whenever you Consume, heal 2 HP, up to 8 each combat.

name: Snecko Soul
description: At the start of each combat, add Soul Roll to your hand.
